summary: Nu Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NU) filed a Form 6-K on July 20, 2026 announcing the acquisition of 100% of Banco Porto Real de Investimentos S.A. via a share purchase agreement. This adds a banking license to Nubank's Brazilian financial conglomerate to comply with Joint Resolution No. 17. The deal does not impose additional capital or liquidity requirements. Completion is subject to Brazilian Central Bank approval. No price per share, premium, or financial terms were disclosed. The transaction aligns with Nubank's previously announced intent (December 2025). Watch for regulatory clearance timeline and any structural adjustments.
